what: member B, stage B4: all four decision heads (exits 12/16/20 and main 32) retrained on the frozen B3 tower under the own-token readout; same script and settings as v6.0-VL's stage 4
out: b-heads-s1 (tower linked to B3; scorer and aux_scorers new)
optimizer: AdamW, weight_decay 0, no schedule, no clipping (as v6.0-VL stage 4)
loss: sum over heads of soft-CE to gold
attention_backend: the MATH SDPA backend on every exit's scorer (--sdpa-math)

data.sources: the B3 spec's text sources (vis* skipped): 141
data.excluded: held-out cases of domain-mix-2 (sha256(case_id) % 10 == 0) and every state of a held-out case of the parent corpus domain-mix-1 (1,916 states)

seed_choice: seed 1 of {0, 1} was named in the averaging experiment's pre-registration before any averaged number was read. Member B's own seed selection had picked seed 0.
